meta.note: Palette and typefaces were not attached. Brand values (Ink 0E1214, Bone F1F0EA, Ember D4572F, Verdigris 3E9C86) and the type (Archivo, IBM Plex Mono) are provisional; swap token values and nothing else changes.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink in the dark theme, Bone in the light theme. Every text token below is checked on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, rails, table bands and the app top bar, one step off bg. Body text and labels sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elevated surface: drawers, dialogs, tooltips, toasts, menus. Elevation is a surface step plus a 1px ring, never a shadow or blur.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panels. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, input outlines and the outline of every chip and button that carries meaning. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised. Bone on Ink in the dark theme, Ink on Bone in the light theme.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, IDs and derivations on bg, surface and surface-raised. At least 6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and controls only. Exempt from contrast because the control is inoperable; always paired with a stated reason.

tokens.name: disabled-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a disabled control. Not a meaning-carrying mark.

tokens.name: threat-observed
tokens.usage: Observed threat: solid hostile thread, evidence marker, attacker-controlled node. Ember means hostile and nothing else. Mark colour, 3:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-raised. Light theme value is Ember deepened for contrast on Bone.

tokens.name: threat-forecast
tokens.usage: Forecast threat: same Ember hue as observed, told apart by form, never by colour. Dotted 2 6 stroke, dashed-ring node, likelihood label.

tokens.name: threat-text
tokens.usage: Hostile-coloured TEXT on bg, surface, surface-raised and threat-soft. A lighter Ember in the dark theme and a deeper Ember in the light theme, because the brand Ember misses 4.5:1 as small text on surfaces.

tokens.name: threat-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind hostile text: blocked-path rows, hostile chip fill. Carries threat-text.

tokens.name: threat-held
tokens.usage: Held: the downstream part of a path that can no longer be reached, Ember at 30%. Intentionally quiet and exempt from 3:1 because every held segment is also labelled HELD.

tokens.name: business
tokens.usage: Business continuity: the preserved thread, a dependency edge, a healthy process node. Verdigris means business and nothing else. 3:1 or more as a mark on every surface. Light theme value is Verdigris deepened for Bone.

tokens.name: business-text
tokens.usage: Business-coloured TEXT on bg, surface, surface-raised and business-soft. At least 4.5:1.

tokens.name: business-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind business text: preserved-path rows, success chip fill. Carries business-text.

tokens.name: proof-ring
tokens.usage: Verified proof: the outer ring of the proof signal and the ProofSeal timeline. Bone in the dark theme, Ink in the light theme. Always paired with proof-core.

tokens.name: proof-core
tokens.usage: Centre of the proof signal: Verdigris, because a verified claim is a claim about preserved business operation.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning: no new hue. Rendered as text colour with a triangle glyph, the word CAUTION and a dashed border, so it never reads as hostile (Ember) or healthy (Verdigris).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: an applied, verified or restored state. Business colour with a check glyph and a word such as APPLIED or VERIFIED, never colour alone.

tokens.name: neutral-evidence
tokens.usage: Neutral evidence and inferred relationships: dashed 6 4 edge, evidence-row marker, inferred node outline. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-threat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid threat-observed fill (a hostile node label or chip). Ink on Ember in the dark theme, white on deepened Ember in the light theme.

tokens.name: on-business
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid business fill.

tokens.name: on-bone
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Bone control fill. In the dark theme this is the primary button label; in the light theme the primary button is Ink, so this is Bone.

tokens.name: action-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and selected state. Bone on Ink, flipped in the light theme. Hover is action-fill-hover.

tokens.name: action-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs. Dims the graph but never hides the business thread entirely.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Product
groups.note: Eight roles. Archivo carries headlines, body and evidence prose; IBM Plex Mono carries labels, data and telemetry. Display and product titles set font-stretch 108% to 112% in bundle.css.

styles.name: display-headline
styles.sample: Stop the attack. Not the business.
styles.usage: Marketing hero and canvas titles. One per page. font-stretch 112%.

styles.name: section-headline
styles.sample: Four claims, each tied to evidence
styles.usage: Panel and section headings inside a screen. font-stretch 108%.

styles.name: product-title
styles.sample: Approve, execute, and keep the way back open
styles.usage: The H1 of each product screen (ThreadGraph, EchoLab, SafeCut, ProofSeal, Action Gate). font-stretch 108%.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Revokes the malicious OAuth grant and nothing else.
styles.usage: Running text and descriptions on bg, surface and surface-raised. Archivo 400, 600 for emphasis.

styles.name: evidence-text
styles.sample: Token replay for S-1 from a new ASN, four minutes after the real sign-in.
styles.usage: Quoted evidence summaries and derivations in evidence rows and claims. text-secondary on surfaces, text in a focused row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, chip words and column heads. IBM Plex Mono, tracked .09em, text-secondary.

styles.name: data-value
styles.usage: Metric values: counts, never bare scores. IBM Plex Mono 500, tabular figures, always followed by its derivation line.

styles.name: telemetry
styles.usage: IDs, hashes, timestamps, solver certificates, code. IBM Plex Mono 400, text on surfaces.

shadow.note: HALT has no shadows and no blur. Elevation is a surface step plus a 1px ring; these tokens are the rings.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Page level: no ring. bg and surface panels separate by line hairlines.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards, tooltips and toasts on surface-raised: a 1px ring in line colour.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Drawers and dialogs: a 1px ring in border-strong, over scrim.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: 2px of page colour, then a solid 2px ring in text colour. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Rhythm unit. Inline gaps, small padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, label-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding, form gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter of the product grid, section gaps in a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margin in the product grid, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing page margin, hero padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Marketing section gap.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every interactive control.

spacing.note: 4px base, 8px rhythm. Every gap in a layout is one of these.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Hairline tables, graph canvas edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags and evidence markers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The HALT radius: buttons, inputs, panels, drawers, dialogs, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Circular graph nodes only (User, Session ring). Never a UI container.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every divider and control outline.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring ring-width, offset by 2px of page colour.

tokens.name: edge-neutral
tokens.usage: Inferred and neutral edges.

tokens.name: edge-threat-forecast
tokens.usage: Forecast hostile edge.

tokens.name: edge-threat-observed
tokens.usage: Observed hostile edge.

tokens.name: edge-business-dependency
tokens.usage: Business dependency edge.

tokens.name: edge-business-preserved
tokens.usage: Preserved business thread. The thickest line in the product on purpose.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus changes on controls.

tokens.name: duration-evidence
tokens.usage: Evidence appearance. Quick and calm: evidence arrives, it does not perform.

tokens.name: duration-approval
tokens.usage: Human approval state change.

tokens.name: duration-switch
tokens.usage: Simulation switching between futures A, B, C.

tokens.name: duration-expand
tokens.usage: Graph expansion, 60ms stagger per hop.

tokens.name: duration-proof
tokens.usage: Proof verification: ring draws, then centre fills.

tokens.name: duration-cut
tokens.usage: Path interruption and rollback reopen.

tokens.name: duration-approach
tokens.usage: Threat propagation toward the target, one pass.

tokens.name: duration-march
tokens.usage: Forecast thread march, looped, ambient.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: Business thread pulse, looped, ambient.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: Whole containment loop on the brand surfaces.

duration.note: Motion is documented in MOTION.md; these are its durations. prefers-reduced-motion shows the end state.

tokens.name: ease-approach
tokens.usage: Threat propagation: accelerates toward the target, so the cut feels late and decisive.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Evidence, expansion, proof: arrives fast, settles softly.

tokens.name: ease-cut
tokens.usage: Path interruption: snaps shut, then holds.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Simulation switching and rollback: symmetrical, deliberate.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Pulse and march: constant, so the business thread reads as steady flow.
